title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet

title: Microsoft 365 Outage Resolving After Nearly 24 Hours
snippet: The ongoing Microsoft 365 outage is resolving after nearly 24 hours. The Microsoft 365 downtime started at approximately 1 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday. Customers could not access their Outlook email or use some features in Teams and Copilot.
